subject: Customer request: retirement of prompt/log artifacts & confirmation delivery
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datatrust.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@datatrust.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: complete retirement of prompt+output artifacts (scope attached)

Hi Michael —

Per our data residency policy review, we need Redwood to fully retire all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and ephemeral logs associated with the 'market-insights' workspace (DataTrust account DH-2145). Scope: prompt history, KV cache entries, transient inference logs, and any derivative short-term traces generated over the last 18 months.

We need:
- Confirmation of the precise artifacts that will be removed (file names / object keys)
- Statement of final proof (ops ticket + checksum-style artifact) we can store in our audit ledger
- Estimated completion window and whether there will be any anonymized audit logs retained

Attached is our retention directive and a signed authorisation from our legal team. Please respond with a plan and a single point of contact for the execution.

Sara Liu
DataTrust Ops
ops@datatrust.com

--attachment: retention_directive_datatrust.pdf (pdf)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datatrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete retirement of prompt+output artifacts (scope attached)

Sara —

Thanks for the clear scope. We can execute this. High-level plan below; ops will share exact object keys and final proofs once the run completes.

Planned steps (estimated 72 hours from start):
1) Intake & verify authorization (we have your signed directive attached) — Security check (Ben)
2) Create ops ticket and run targeted KV-cache eviction + object delete for the workspace keys — Ops (Marissa)
3) Sweep ephemeral inference logs and redact any PII; generate proof bundle with checksums and a runbook snapshot (erase_runbook_v3.pdf attached).
4) Deliver DocuSign acceptance form for your records (one-click signature) and the ops ticket link, then close.

Questions:
- Do you require us to preserve any anonymized time-series metrics for SLA reporting? If yes, we will include a retention-exemption note in the proof.
- Are there any third-party integrations we should notify (S3 replication buckets, third-party analytics)?

I’ll loop Marissa to schedule the run.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--attachment: erase_runbook_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datatrust.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete retirement of prompt+output artifacts (scope attached)

Sara —

Ops will perform a two-stage execution to minimize risk:
Stage A (non-destructive verification) — enumerate keys and present a candidate list (~4 hours). We will not delete until you sign the DocuSign form.
Stage B (execution) — 1) lock-write to prevent new writes to the workspace 2) evict KV cache, delete prompt-output objects, scrub transient logs 3) run verification job that outputs a signed manifest and SHA256 checksums.

We will open ticket RED-78932 with full run artifacts. ETA: candidate list to you by Tue 2026-06-02 12:00 PDT; execution within 24–48 hours after signed acceptance.

Note: For compliance, we propose retaining an anonymized audit trail (timestamps + event codes, no content). If that’s unacceptable, we can remove those too but need explicit confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Ops Lead, Customer Removals
Redwood Inference

--attachment: ops_ticket_78932.log (txt stub)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datatrust.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete retirement of prompt+output artifacts (scope attached)

Thanks — confirming we received the candidate list (see inline notes). We will sign the DocuSign form at 17:00 PDT after a quick legal check; DataTrust requests full removal including anonymized audit trails (we do not want retention of even event-only metadata). Please confirm you can remove all audit timestamps as well and still provide a verifiable proof (we accept run manifests with checksums but no retained metadata fields).

Acceptance note: we want the run manifest and checksums plus a short statement from Redwood that no content or metadata from the scope remains in Redwood-managed storage or caches. Once we sign, schedule to start immediately.

Sara Liu
DataTrust Ops
